dedupe_keys.name: barrierefreiheit an haltestellen opnv baden wurttemberg

description: Barrierefreiheit an Haltestellen (ÖPNV) Baden-Württemberg is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. In Baden-Württemberg werden die Bahnhöfe und Haltepunkte (SPNV) sowie die Bushaltestellen (ÖPNV) hinsichtlich ihrer Eignung zur Nutzung durch mobilitätseingeschränkte Personen vor Ort geprüft. Dazu hat die NVBW Nahverkehrsgesellschaft Baden-Württemberg mbH für das Verkehrsministerium BW einen Kriterienkatalog definiert, der auf dem Handbuch "Barrierefreie Reiseketten in der Fahrgastinformation" der DELFI Version basiert. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are barrierefreiheit, haltestellen, mobidata-bw, öpnv. It offers 20 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/BIN, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
